items.title: Cybersecurity agency clarifies extension granted only to Reddit, not Discord

items.description: Business groups are urging the government to strengthen safeguards and enforcement mechanisms under a bill barring families of public officials from securing government contracts.

items.title: Camille urges respect for absent senators
items.description: Sen. Camille Villar teared up as she rebuked Sen. Erwin Tulfo for citing the plunder charges against their detained colleagues during a debate on the conviction threshold yesterday.

items.title: Metrobank art awardees turn perspectives into possibilities
items.description: Drawing from the world around them and their own experiences, the 2026 Metrobank Art & Design Excellence grand awardees transformed themes of power, perseverance and human connection into compelling works that invite audiences to reflect, see familiar realities from different perspectives and consider new possibilities.

items.title: ‘US call to quit ICC won’t affect Duterte trial’
items.description: US President Donald Trump’s call for countries to leave the International Criminal Court (ICC) would not affect the ongoing trial of former president Rodrigo Duterte, who is facing crimes against humanity charges over deaths linked to his drug war, Malacañang said yesterday.

items.title: House wraps up OP budget talks
items.description: The House of Representatives terminated plenary deliberations yesterday on the proposed P10.16-billion budget for the Office of the President (OP) for 2027, along with those of the Presidential Communications Office , Presidential Management Staff (PMS) and the Department of Tourism (DOT).

items.title: AMLC freezes P24.7 billion assets in flood mess
items.description: The government, through the Anti-Money Laundering Council, has so far frozen a total of P24.7 billion in assets of alleged corrupt officials linked to the multibillion-peso flood control scam ordered investigated by President Marcos in 2025.

items.title: Marcos vows better protection for Pinoy sailors
items.description: President Marcos yesterday vowed to strengthen safeguards and assistance for Filipino seafarers, particularly those working in war-risk areas.

items.title: Absolute pardon mulled for Veloso
items.description: President Marcos is considering granting an absolute pardon to Mary Jane Veloso, who has been detained for over a decade following her conviction in Indonesia for drug trafficking, Malacañang said yesterday.
